title: Deterministic physics model END-TO-END on IndEgo (in-domain, 150 labels)
why: Q5 showed the IndEgo-derived rules reject 99.55% of Egocentric-10K (no transfer). The rules must be tested where they are valid: run the full deterministic path (decode -> Q5 physics extractor -> frozen rule table -> receipt) on the 150 human-labelled IndEgo windows and report honest LOCO metrics, determinism and throughput.
hypothesis: In-domain the frozen deterministic rule table reproduces Q1's LOCO AUROC (~0.822), is byte-for-byte deterministic, and is competitive with the learned baselines at a fraction of the decision cost.
data: 150 IndEgo human-gold windows (100 good / 50 bad), 7 clips; full path re-extracted on all 150 + cached gold matrices
method: full deterministic path per window (CPU ffmpeg decode 160x90 -> jadal.perpixel.physics.extract_physics + jadal.gpu.features.cpu_window_features -> frozen rule table reject_threshold=14 -> ACCEPT/REJECT/REVIEW + canonical receipt via tools/phys/model.py); LOCO AUROC/BA/REVIEW/per-rule/confusion; 10x receipt determinism; throughput split

summary: In-domain deterministic physics model WORKS: LOCO AUROC 0.8224 (CI 0.715-0.861) on 150 human labels, identical on the re-extracted end-to-end path; vs logistic 26-feat 0.8016 (-0.021, rules better) and EG2 0.8458 (+0.023). fr5 operating point (5% FR): BA decided-only 0.808, review=miss 0.37, REVIEW 0.60, coverage 0.40, bad recall 0.52, FP 10/100. Frozen-table in-sample AUROC 0.8239. Shipped verdicts (frozen table): accept 20 / reject 26 / review 104. Per-rule precision 0.33-0.57 (BLUR/NO_ACTIVE_WORK/CODING_NOISE strongest). Determinism: 10x scorer on all 150 windows byte-identical receipt_sha256 + feature_digest; end-to-end re-extraction 2x on 14 windows identical. Throughput: 693.5 ms/window single-thread CPU (decode 198 ms 28.6%, features 492 ms 71.0%, decision 2.75 ms 0.4%) = 14.4 footage-h/wall-h. Cache vs re-extract 12/14 exact (only full.temp_b0/b1/b2 from an earlier cache kernel revision; 149/150 verdicts agree).
decision: Ship the deterministic rule list as the primary in-domain explainable scorer; do NOT deploy out-of-domain without re-quantiling (Q5). Per-window receipts in eval/results/exp_phys/windows_q6.jsonl.
cost: CPU only, no GPU; 150 windows end-to-end 104 s wall; decision stage 2.75 ms/window
